params.message:
Give shared links their own page under the account menu

Making and revoking links sat in a fold on the Bouwsoft page because
that page was once the only one a link opened, and its text still said
so. A link now opens Bespreken, Netwerk, Bouwsoft and Medewerkers, so the
form and the list of active links move to their own page, Delen met een
link (/delen), in the account menu for everybody signed in, and the text
says what a link opens and what it does not. Links already handed out
keep working; somebody on a link cannot open the page.
